updates.title: The board goes up
items: Heredita is in **pre-alpha** and runs in the browser at app.heredita.net — no launcher, no download, nothing to patch.
Play as a guest, or make an account to keep your profile between devices.
Chat, friends and countryball avatars are in. The store and Heredita Coins are not open yet.
Real patch notes start landing here with the next build.
